name: Lippi Systems Limited
about: Lippi Systems Limited manufactures roto gravure printing cylinders in India. Its products are used in rotogravure printing, anilox rollers for Flexo, adhesive coating, and decorative printing applications. The company is also involved in generating power from wind turbine generator; and trading business of goods. Lippi Systems Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
